rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for goods being sold, especially a vendor’s stock.

example.english: The wares at this stall are affordable and attractive, so all the neighbours come to shop here.
example.traditional: 呢檔嘅貨又平又靚，街坊個個都嚟幫襯。
example.jyutping: ne1 dong3 ge3 fo3 jau6 ping4 jau6 leng3 gaai1 fong1 go3 go3 dou1 lai4 bong1 can3

rows.note: Use this for a more neutral or formal reference to goods offered for sale.

example.english: The shopping centre will inspect all the wares first to ensure they meet safety standards.
example.traditional: 商場會先檢查所有貨品，確保符合安全標準。
